decisions.Kwic: 威音那畔一句圓該，全體現前纖塵不立

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanjie Ying (元潔瑩禪師語錄), in Yuanjie Ying's opening hall address at Ancient Dongshan Anou Chan Monastery. Yuanjie Ying is the exact speaker who says that a phrase from beyond Awesome Sound encompasses the whole and that the complete body appears with not a mote established. Dongshan in the venue heading names the monastery; it does not make Dongshan Liangjie the speaker of this address.
